module.name: timeout-value
module.description: Recognize supported numeric timeout expressions without executing source code; use Number.NaN internally for invalid values.

specifications.feature: Recognize supported numeric timeout expressions without executing source code.

scenarios.name: should accept numeric arithmetic
scenarios.given: numeric literals, stable aliases, arithmetic operators, and unary signs
scenarios.then: positive finite results and unresolved numeric runtime expressions are accepted

scenarios.name: should reject disabled numeric results
scenarios.given: zero, negative, nonfinite, or unsupported expressions
scenarios.then: the expression is rejected without coercion or execution

scenarios.name: should resolve logical fallbacks
scenarios.given: numeric, nullish, or unresolved logical operands
scenarios.then: known branches are selected and known disabled fallback values are rejected

scenarios.name: should distinguish runtime options objects
scenarios.given: an unresolved identifier, call, or member expression
scenarios.then: runtime options are accepted while numeric expressions are rejected

scenarios.name: should stop evaluation of cyclic expression aliases
scenarios.given: self-referential or mutually recursive aliases inside arithmetic or fallback expressions
scenarios.then: the expressions are rejected without unbounded recursion

scenarios.name: should reject unshadowed invalid globals
scenarios.given: global NaN, Infinity, or undefined used directly, through aliases, or in supported timeout expressions
scenarios.when: a numeric timeout or runtime timeout object is checked
scenarios.then: the invalid global value is rejected

scenarios.name: should respect shadowed special-value bindings
scenarios.given: parameters or local declarations named NaN, Infinity, or undefined
scenarios.when: timeouts and logical fallbacks are checked
scenarios.then: known initializers are validated and unknown parameter values remain runtime values instead of being classified by name
